key_idea: Each rung between lines a and a+1 swaps the elements currently travelling on those two lines.
sketch: Keep an array pos[i] = element currently on vertical line i, initially the identity, and for each rung from top to bottom swap pos[a] and pos[a+1]. Print the array at the end, which lists the element ending in each position. O(n+m). The only pitfall is the output direction: print which element lands in each slot, not where each element goes.
